learning_objective: 🎯 You will learn how to set up your own mini plant nursery, identify essential gardening tools, and master the practical skills to grow healthy saplings from tiny seeds!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A plant nursery is like a cozy kindergarten for plants! It is a carefully managed place where young plants, trees, and flowers are grown from seeds under strict protection until they are strong enough to survive in an open garden or field.

Nurseries can specialize in growing different things. There are vegetable nurseries for tasty food crops, ornamental nurseries for beautiful decorative flowers, and fruit nurseries for orchards. Some are even set up strictly to grow large trees to build forests!

Every good gardener needs the right tools to work safely and efficiently. A 'trowel' (khurpi) is used for digging small holes and moving soil, a 'watering can' provides a gentle rain-like shower for delicate seeds, and 'pruning shears' help trim away dead leaves.

Plants need yummy food to grow tall and strong! A good nursery bed mixes regular soil with 'compost' (natural, eco-friendly fertilizer made from decayed leaves and kitchen waste). This makes the soil loose, rich in nutrients, and perfect for tiny roots to spread.

Seeds are like sleeping babies. To wake them up (a process called germination), they need exactly the right amount of water, warmth, and sunlight. Once they sprout leaves and become 'saplings', they need daily monitoring to stay safe from harsh weather and pests.

fun_activity.title: 🪴 DIY Paper Cup Nursery Challenge!
fun_activity.instructions: Punch a tiny hole at the bottom of a recycled paper cup, fill it with moist soil, and plant 3-4 mustard or fenugreek seeds. Keep it on your windowsill, water it gently every day, and count how many days it takes for the first green leaves to pop out!

quick_recap: ⭐ A plant nursery is a protected, nurturing environment where seeds grow into healthy saplings.
⭐ Nurseries can be categorized based on what they grow: flowers, vegetables, fruits, or forest trees.
⭐ Basic gardening tools like a trowel and a watering can make nursery tasks easier and protect the delicate plants.
⭐ Mixing compost into the soil gives seeds the vital nutrients they need for strong root development.
⭐ Proper water, sunlight, and care are essential for successful seed germination.
